headline: Brazil Approves Priority List of 27 Critical and Strategic Minerals
summary: Brazil's National Council for the Industrialization of Critical and Strategic Minerals approved a priority list of 27 minerals classified into three tiers to guide public policy and resource allocation.
why: Government policy frameworks for critical minerals direct capital expenditure and development resources toward strategic mining supply chains.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Establishing a priority classification for critical minerals guides resource allocation and public policy in Brazil.
